faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Important insights into our AI engine, data confidentiality, and hiring workflows.
faq.q1: What criteria does the AI scoring engine use?
faq.a1: Our AI evaluates based on 4 primary weights: Technical Skills, Semantic Context (NLP), Work Experience, and Educational Qualifications.
faq.q2: Is my resume and candidate data secure?
faq.a2: Absolutely. We enforce AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Your profile is only shared when you deliberately apply.
faq.q3: How do I register an Employer / Enterprise account?
faq.a3: Enterprises provide their Tax Identification Number and Business License. Our team verifies (KYC) within 24 working hours.
faq.hint: Didn't find what you need? Our customer support team is always ready to help.
